meta.title: Briise : site d'exemple Vérac Plomberie Chauffage (fictif)
meta.description: Installe l'extension Briise Socle et le thème Briise depuis GitHub, dépose les photos d'exemple (Unsplash) et importe le fichier de site du plombier fictif.
meta.author: Briise

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/media.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/file.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/image.php';
wp_set_current_user( 1 );
$photos = array(
  'plombier' => 'photo-1749532125405-70950966b0e5', 'fuite' => 'photo-1676210134188-4c05dd172f89', 'robinet' => 'photo-1521207418485-99c705420785',
  'chauffe-eau' => 'photo-1650551182991-b07558247564', 'chaudiere' => 'photo-1770625467384-304e461ef1be', 'pompe-a-chaleur' => 'photo-1776860155275-eee24bfb1dee',
  'salle-de-bains' => 'photo-1584622650111-993a426fbf0a', 'douche' => 'photo-1714894691666-e8bb020c781c', 'radiateur' => 'photo-1669725341213-7379ff6c90d5',
  'outils' => 'photo-1783587354869-de09cfffaf9a', 'camionnette' => 'photo-1641199788912-9a7385a35c82', 'thomas' => 'photo-1769200353672-4560816cfcde',
);
$journal = array();
foreach ( $photos as $nom => $id ) {
  $tmp = download_url( 'https://images.unsplash.com/' . $id . '?w=1600&q=80&fm=jpg&fit=max', 60 );
  if ( is_wp_error( $tmp ) ) { $journal[] = $nom . ' : ' . $tmp->get_error_message(); continue; }
  $att = media_handle_sideload( array( 'name' => 'verac-' . $nom . '.jpg', 'tmp_name' => $tmp ), 0, 'Photo d’exemple Unsplash (site fictif)' );
  $journal[] = $nom . ' : ' . ( is_wp_error( $att ) ? $att->get_error_message() : 'ok' );
}
foreach ( array( 1, 2 ) as $id ) { wp_delete_post( $id, true ); }
$json = wp_remote_retrieve_body( wp_remote_get( 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BriiseA/briise-theme/ajout/personnalite/.github/outils/exemples/site-verac.json', array( 'timeout' => 60 ) ) );
$plan = briise_plan_depuis_fichier( $json );
$r = is_wp_error( $plan ) ? array( 'erreur' => $plan->get_error_message() ) : briise_plan_installer( $plan );
update_option( 'briise_essai_playground', array( 'photos' => $journal, 'import' => $r ), false );
